title: Burkina Faso Orders Major Curriculum Overhaul
excerpt: Burkina Faso‘s military government has announced a comprehensive overhaul of its history, geography, and civic education curricula. The government said the changes are intended to “decolonise” what students are taught as the new school year begins. Higher Education Minister Moumouni Zoungrana said the reform was carried out at the instruction of the prime minister and aimed to correct content inherited from the colonial period. Speaking at a government event in Ouagadougou, he said the country needed to stop presenting its own history through a foreign lens. “We have decided to review these curricula, remove words that treat us like children or animals, and add chapters that promote our values,” Zoungrana wrote. “When you open our textbooks, we are portrayed as mere objects. Our victories were never highlighted; on the contrary, the focus was on our defeats and our negative traits.” The country was a French colony until 1960. School textbooks have not yet been revised, according to a history and geography teacher in the capital, Ouagadougou, but the ministry has distributed a booklet
article_summary: Burkina Faso‘s military government has announced a comprehensive overhaul of its history, geography, and civic education curricula. The government said the changes are intended to “decolonise” what students are taught as the new school year begins. Higher Education Minister Moumouni Zoungrana said the reform was carried out at the instruction of the prime minister and aimed to correct content inherited from the colonial period.

"Je suis parti me renseigner au niveau du gouvernorat de Kidal délocalisé à Gao. Beaucoup de mes collègues veulent aussi retourner, mais nous ne savons pas comment, avec le manque de ressources. Si l’armée ou même l’Etat peut nous proposer des véhicules militaires pour amener des gens, nous sommes prêts. Parce que les gens ont tout laissé derrière eux. Ils n’ont rien." title: Soudan : 1.770 personnes déplacées dans l’Etat du Nil bleu, selon l’OIM
translated_title: Sudan: 1,770 people displaced in Blue Nile State, according to IOM
excerpt: Bamako, 7 octobre (AMAP) Quelque 1.770 personnes issues de 354 ménages ont été déplacées lundi de plusieurs villages de l’État du Nil Bleu, dans le sud du Soudan, en raison de la dégradation de la situation sécuritaire, a indiqué mardi l’Organisation internationale pour les migrations (OIM). Selon l’OIM, les déplacements ont été enregistrés dans plusieurs villages de la localité de Wad al-Mahi. Les personnes déplacées ont rejoint la localité d’Al-Rosaires, dans le même État. Ces nouveaux déplacements portent à 5.525 le nombre de personnes ayant fui les villages de Wad al-Mahi en trois jours, soit 1.105 ménages, selon l’agence onusienne. L’OIM avait fait état lundi de la fuite de 955 personnes dimanche, puis de 2.800 personnes samedi, toujours en raison de la détérioration de la sécurité. Le Nil Bleu connaît une intensification des affrontements ces derniers jours, alors que les Forces de soutien rapide (FSR) et le Mouvement populaire de libération du Soudan-Nord, allié aux FSR, ont lancé des attaques dans plusieurs zones. Selon un bilan publié le 13 septembre, l’OIM avait recensé 99.

According to IOM, the displacements were recorded in several villages in the locality of Wad al-Mahi .

title: Au Mali, la reprise de Kidal «consolide» la Transition
translated_title: In Mali, the takeover of Kidal "consolidates" the Transition
excerpt: Au Mali, la reprise de Kidal «consolide» la Transition Au Mali, l'armée et ses partenaires russes de l'Africa Corps ont réinvesti mardi 6 octobre la ville de Kidal, dans le nord du pays, moins de six mois après en avoir été chassés par les indépendantistes du FLA et leurs alliés jihadistes du Jnim, liés à al-Qaïda. Cette victoire de prestige a été acquise sans même avoir à combattre, les groupes armés s'étant retirés avant l'arrivée de l'armée. Elle consacre un rapport de force, conforte les autorités de transition au pouvoir, soulève des interrogations sur le rôle de l'Algérie et crée de nouveaux défis pour Bamako. Publié le : Dans un communiqué diffusé mardi soir, le gouvernement de transition salue sobrement la « consolidation » de son dispositif à Kidal - « une perspective favorable au retour progressif de l'administration » et « à une vie normale » - et laisse les discours triomphalistes à ses influenceurs, dans les médias et sur les réseaux sociaux. Une habile manière d'effacer du récit officiel l'humiliante défaite d'avril dernier et le contrôle de la ville par les indépendant
translated_excerpt: In Mali, the takeover of Kidal "consolidates" the Transition In Mali, the army and its Russian partners of the Africa Corps reinvested Tuesday, October 6, the city of Kidal, in the north of the country, less than six months after being driven out by the separatists of the Fla and their jihadist allies of the Jnim, linked to al-Qaeda. This prestigious victory was achieved without even having to fight, as the armed groups withdrew before the arrival of the army . It enshrines a balance of power, reinforces the transitional authorities in power, raises questions about Algeria's role and creates new challenges for Bamako. Published on: In a press release issued Tuesday evening, the transitional government soberly welcomes the "consolidation" of its system in Kidal - "a prospect favorable to the gradual return of the administration" and "to a normal life" - and leaves the speeches triumphalists to their influencers, in the media and on social networks. A clever way to erase from the official narrative the humiliating defeat of last April and the control of the city by the independents
article_summary: In Mali, the army and its Russian partners of the Africa Corps reinvested Tuesday, October 6, the city of Kidal, in the north of the country, less than six months after being driven out by the separatists of the Fla and their jihadist allies of the Jnim, linked to al-Qaeda. This prestigious victory was achieved without even having to fight, as the armed groups withdrew before the arrival of the army .

title: Les FAMa entrent à Kidal après le retrait du FLA
translated_title: FAMa enter Kidal after Fla withdrawal

Dans une déclaration lue à la télévision nationale, le porte-parole du gouvernement, le général de brigade Issa Ousmane Coulibaly, a annoncé que les forces nationales avaient repris le contrôle de cette capitale régionale du nord du pays. Selon le gouvernement, l’opération a mobilisé des moyens terrestres et aériens avec l’appui de partenaires russes. L’état-major avait annoncé, plus tôt dans la journée, le lancement d’opérations « aéroterrestres d’envergure » dans la région de Kidal dans le cadre de l’opération Dougoukoloko. Les militaires maliens et leurs soutiens russes sont entrés dans Kidal dans l’après-midi. Le communiqué gouvernement indique que les forces renforçaient leur présence dans la ville mardi soir. Dans un communiqué rendu plus tôt dans la journée, le FLA que ce retrait visait à préserver les hommes et le matériel du groupe. Le mouvement séparatiste affirme que son retrait s’est déroulé sans combat direct avec les forces qui entraient dans la ville. L
translated_excerpt: The Malian Armed Forces entered Kidal on Tuesday, October 6, five months after leaving the city. In a statement read on national television, government spokesman Brigadier General Issa Ousmane Coulibaly announced that national forces had regained control of this northern regional capital According to the government, the operation mobilized ground and air assets with the support of Russian partners. The General Staff had announced, earlier in the day, the launch of "major air-land operations" in the Kidal region as part of Operation Dougoukoloko. Malian military and their Russian backers entered Kidal in the afternoon . The government statement indicates that the forces were strengthening their presence in the city on Tuesday evening. In a statement earlier in the day, the Fla said the withdrawal was aimed at preserving the group's men and equipment. The separatist movement claims that its withdrawal took place without direct combat with the forces entering the city.

title: Burkina: la gendarmerie nationale à la recherche de Boureima Sanfo
translated_title: Burkina: the national gendarmerie in search of Boureima Sanfo
excerpt: La gendarmerie nationale burkinabè est à la recherche de Boureima Sanfo, un commerçant de 51 ans à Hamelé dans la province du Ioba, dans la partie sud-ouest du Burkina Faso, pour des faits d’ «abus de confiance», selon un avis lancé, ce mercredi 7 octobre 2026. Le commerçant Boureima Sanfo est recherché par la gendarmerie nationale pour «abus de confiance portant sur la somme de plus de 40 000 000 F CFA». «Toute personnes disposant d’informations permettant de le localiser est priée de les communiquer immédiatement à la gendarmerie nationale ou le service de sécurité le plus proche. Il est recommandé de ne pas intervenir directement», lance la gendarmerie dans son avis de recherche. Par Wakat Séra

The trader Boureima Sanfo is wanted by the national gendarmerie for "breach of trust relating to the sum of more than 40,000,000 CFA francs" . title: Mali Army Retakes Kidal With Russian Support
excerpt: Mali Army Retakes Kidal With Russian Support Mali's army, backed by Russian paramilitary forces, has retaken the northern town of Kidal after Tuareg separatists announced a "strategic and controlled withdrawal" from the area. The Azawad Liberation Front said its forces withdrew without direct fighting, attributing the move to what it described as the disproportionate use of air power by Russia's Africa Corps. Kidal has long been a stronghold of Tuareg separatists seeking an independent state in northern Mali. The separatists and an al-Qaeda-linked group previously seized it. The recapture is being viewed as a symbolic victory for Mali's military government, which has increasingly turned to Russia for military support after distancing itself from France. Analysts said, however, that the development is unlikely to be decisive in the broader fight against jihadist and separatist groups. Human rights organisations continue to accuse both Malian and Russian forces of abuses against civilians. title: Mali: Junta Forces Retake Strategic Town of Kidal
excerpt: Mali's military regained control of the strategic town of Kidal after forcing Tuareg separatists and al-Qaeda-linked jihadists to withdraw following an offensive backed by Russia's Africa Corps. Mali's army, supported by Russian paramilitary forces, has re-entered the northern town of Kidal, forcing the Tuareg separatists to withdraw from the strategic hold, in a symbolic boost for the country's military government and its Russian allies. The Tuareg separatist Azawad Liberation Front (FLA) said in a statement it had "decided to carry out a strategic and controlled withdrawal of its forces from the town of Kidal." It said the withdrawal took place without direct fighting. This followed the "disproportionate use of aerial assets by Russian mercenaries from the Africa Corps," according to an FLA spokesperson. title: Défense du territoire national : des mercenaires du MPLJ mis en déroute par les FDS à Dibiella

title: Mali: Junta forces retake strategic town of Kidal
excerpt: Mali's army, supported by Russian paramilitary forces, has re-entered the northern town of Kidal, forcing the Tuareg separatists to withdraw from the strategic hold, in a symbolic boost for the country's military government and its Russian allies. The Tuareg separatist Azawad Liberation Front (FLA) said in a statement it had "decided to carry out a strategic and controlled withdrawal of its forces from the town of Kidal." It said the withdrawal took place without direct fighting. This followed the "disproportionate use of aerial assets by Russian mercenaries from the Africa Corps," according to an FLA spokesperson. How did Kidal fall earlier this year? The FLA and al-Qaeda-linked Jama'at Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin (JNIM) seized Kidal during a series of attacks earlier this year in April that also killed Mali's defense minister. Tuareg separatists from the Azawad Liberation Front have been fighting for years to create an independent state in northern Mali. title: Sécurisation du territoire national : les FAMa renforcent leur dispositif à Kidal
translated_title: Securing the national territory: the FAMa are strengthening their system in Kidal
excerpt: Bamako, 6 oct (AMAP)- Les Forces armées maliennes (FAMa), appuyées par leurs partenaires russes, ont renforcé et consolidé mardi leur dispositif à Kidal, dans le cadre de l’opération Dougoukoloko, a annoncé le gouvernement dans un communiqué publié aujourd’hui. Selon le document, ce renforcement fait suite à des «intenses opérations aéroterrestres de neutralisation» menées contre une coalition de groupes terroristes. Les FAMa avaient récemment réarticulé leur dispositif opérationnel, notamment autour d’Anéfif et d’Aguel-hoc, après des attaques terroristes qualifiées de complexes et coordonnées. Le gouvernement précise que les opérations en cours s’inscrivent dans le cadre de «l’exercice effectif de la souveraineté de l’État sur l’ensemble du territoire national». Il assure de la poursuite des opérations de défense de l’intégrité territoriale. Les autorités appellent les populations au calme et assurent que la protection des personnes et de leurs biens demeure une priorité pour les FAMa. OS/CMT (AMAP)
translated_excerpt: Bamako, Oct 6 (AMAP)- The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their Russian partners, strengthened and consolidated their operations in Kidal on Tuesday, as part of Operation Dougoukoloko, the government announced in a statement issued today. According to the document, this reinforcement follows "intense air-land neutralization operations" carried out against a coalition of terrorist groups . The FAMa had recently re-articulated their operational system, particularly around Anéfif and Aguel-hoc, after terrorist attacks described as complex and coordinated. The government specifies that the current operations are part of the "effective exercise of the sovereignty of the State over the entire national territory". It ensures the continuation of operations to defend territorial integrity . The authorities call on the populations to calm down and ensure that the protection of people and their property remains a priority for the FAMa. OS/CMT (AMAP)
article_summary: Bamako, Oct 6 (AMAP)- The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their Russian partners, strengthened and consolidated their operations in Kidal on Tuesday, as part of Operation Dougoukoloko, the government announced in a statement issued today. According to the document, this reinforcement follows "intense air-land neutralization operations" carried out against a coalition of terrorist groups .

title: Opération DOUGOUKOLOKO : Les FAMa et leurs partenaires russes intensifient l’offensive dans les théâtres Est et Centre
translated_title: Operation DOUGOUKOLOKO: The FAMa and their Russian partners intensify the offensive in the Eastern and Central theaters
excerpt: Dans le prolongement de son précédent communiqué, l’État-Major Général des Armées informe l’opinion nationale que les Forces armées maliennes (FAMa), appuyées par leurs partenaires russes, poursuivent l’offensive d’envergure lancée ce mardi 06 octobre 2026 dans le théâtre Est, dans le cadre de l’opération DOUGOUKOLOKO. Cette opération vise notamment à renforcer la sécurisation des populations vivant dans cette partie du territoire national, à garantir la libre circulation des personnes et des biens, à sécuriser les frontières et à porter un coup d’arrêt à l’économie criminelle développée par les groupes armés terroristes (GAT). Les opérations aéroterrestres conduites ce jour dans les secteurs de Kidal, In-Tassik, Tin-Assalak et Abéïbara ont permis, à ce stade, de neutraliser plusieurs terroristes et de détruire des véhicules ainsi que des dépôts logistiques appartenant aux groupes armés terroristes. Dans le même temps, sur le théâtre Centre, plusieurs points de regroupement terroristes ont été identifiés, ciblés et traités avec précision dans les secteurs de Tombouctou et de Sofara.
translated_excerpt: In line with its previous communiqué, the General Staff of the Armed Forces informs the national opinion that the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their Russian partners, are continuing the large-scale offensive launched on Tuesday, October 6, 2026 in the Eastern Theater, as part of Operation DOUGOUKOLOKO . This operation aims in particular to strengthen the security of the populations living in this part of the national territory, to guarantee the free movement of people and goods, to secure the borders and to stop the criminal economy developed by the armed terrorist groups (GAT) . The air-land operations conducted today in the sectors of Kidal, In-Tassik, Tin-Assalak and Abéïbara have made it possible, at this stage, to neutralize several terrorists and destroy vehicles as well as logistical depots belonging to the armed terrorist groups

This operation aims in particular to strengthen the security of the populations living in this part of the national territory, to guarantee the free movement of people and goods, to secure the borders and to stop the criminal economy developed by the armed terrorist groups (GAT) .

translated_title: Aguelhoc: nearly 8,000 displaced people and host families benefit from WFP food stamps

title: Generative AI Alters the Battlefield in Mali
excerpt: There is an information war being fought in Mali online and on social media platforms. A new study outlines how generative artificial intelligence is being used by state, nonstate and foreign entities to push propaganda and misinformation. A September 9 report by the Dakar-based Timbuktu Institute, titled “Algorithms at War: How Generative AI is Reshaping the Malian Conflict,” examined al-Qaida affiliate Jama’at Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin (JNIM), the Malian government, Russia’s Africa Corps and the Tuareg separatist group Azawad Liberation Front (FLA). “It is entirely possible that Mali could become a veritable laboratory for AI-assisted information warfare,” the report stated. “While the most advanced kinetic applications remain largely speculative for now, the battle of narratives is already underway. In an increasingly saturated information landscape, the ability to distinguish the real from the fabricated is itself becoming a security issue.” The FLA has used AI as an anonymization tool and to create, disseminate and amplify content based on AI-generated characters on social me
article_summary: There is an information war being fought in Mali online and on social media platforms. A new study outlines how generative artificial intelligence is being used by state, nonstate and foreign entities to push propaganda and misinformation. A September 9 report by the Dakar-based Timbuktu Institute, titled “Algorithms at War: How Generative AI is Reshaping the Malian Conflict,” examined al-Qaida affiliate Jama’at Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin (JNIM), the Malian government, Russia’s Africa Corps and the Tuareg separatist group Azawad Liberation Front (FLA).

title: Mali: les forces armées reprennent Kidal
translated_title: Mali: Armed forces retake Kidal
excerpt: Les Forces armées maliennes (FAMa) ont repris le contrôle de Kidal, une ville située à environ 1 530 kilomètres au Nord de Bamako, ce mardi 6 octobre 2026, selon plusieurs sources médiatiques. L’armée malienne est entrée de nouveau à Kidal, la capitale de la région du Nord du pays qui était assiégée par les groupes rebelles et autres terroristes depuis quelques mois. Plusieurs sources médiatiques confirment cette information après avoir contacté des officiers de l’armée malienne qui ont mené plusieurs heures d’opérations avec l’appui de leurs partenaires russes, dans la région de Kidal. Dans un communiqué publié avant l’entrée des forces maliennes dans la ville, l’état-major général des armées avait indiqué que les FAMa et leurs partenaires russes avaient engagé des «opérations aéroterrestres d’envergure» dans le cadre de la réadaptation du dispositif de l’opération «Dougoukoloko». Le communiqué précise que ces opérations visent notamment à «traquer et neutraliser les groupes armés terroristes» opérant dans la région, détruire leurs «sanctuaires et leurs réseaux d’approvisionnement»
translated_excerpt: The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) regained control of Kidal, a town about 1,530 kilometers north of Bamako, on Tuesday, October 6, 2026, according to several media sources. The Malian army re-entered Kidal, the capital of the country's northern region that had been under siege by rebel groups and other terrorists for a few months Several media sources confirm this information after contacting Malian army officers who conducted several hours of operations with the support of their Russian partners, in the Kidal region In a statement issued before the Malian forces entered the city, the General Staff of the Armed Forces had indicated that the FAMa and their Russian partners had engaged in "large-scale air-land operations" as part of the rehabilitation of the operation "Dougoukoloko"
article_summary: The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) regained control of Kidal, a town about 1,530 kilometers north of Bamako, on Tuesday, October 6, 2026, according to several media sources.

title: مالي.. الجيش يدخل كيدال من دون مقاومة
translated_title: Mali.. The army enters Kidal without resistance
excerpt: دخل الجيش المالي وشركاؤه الروس مدينة كيدال شمال شرق البلاد، بعد ظهر الثلاثاء 6 أكتوبر، في إطار عملية عسكرية لاستعادة المدينة الاستراتيجية، حسب مصادر محلية. ولم يعلن الجيش ذلك بشكل رسمي، لكن إذاعة فرنسا الدولية، قالت إن الجيش المالي وصل إلى كيدال من دون أن يواجه مقاومة أو يخوض معارك، بعد انسحاب جبهة تحرير أزواد من المدينة. وكان الجيش قد عزز مواقعه في أنيفيس وأغيلهوك خلال عطلة نهاية الأسبوع، تمهيدًا لهجوم يهدف إلى استعادة كيدال، التي سيطرت عليها في أبريل الماضي جبهة تحرير أزواد (FLA) ، إلى جانب جماعة نصرة الإسلام والمسلمين (JNIM) المرتبطة بتنظيم القاعدة. وأعلنت جبهة أزواد اليوم الثلاثاء انساحبها من المدينة، مشيرة إلى أن “هذا الإجراء تدبير عملياتي مؤقت، يهدف كذلك إلى الحفاظ على قدراتها البشرية واللوجستية في كامل جاهزيتها. وقد تم هذا الانسحاب المنظم من المدينة دون أن تخوض قوات الجبهة، حتى الآن، أي مواجهة مباشرة.”
translated_excerpt: The Malian army and its Russian partners entered the northeastern city of Kidal on the afternoon of Tuesday, October 6, as part of a military operation to retake the strategic city, according to local sources. The army did not announce this officially, but Radio France Internationale said that the Malian army arrived in Kidal without facing resistance or fighting battles, after the withdrawal of the Front for the Liberation of Azawad from the city The army had reinforced its positions in Anifis and Aguelhok over the weekend, in preparation for an offensive aimed at recapturing Kidal, which was seized last April by the Front for the Liberation of Azawad (Fla) , along with the al-Qaeda-linked group JNIM. On Tuesday, the Azawad Front announced its withdrawal from the city, noting that "this measure is a temporary operational measure, which also aims to maintain its human and logistical capabilities in full readiness. This orderly withdrawal from the city has taken place without the Front's forces having, so far, engaged in any direct confrontation.”
article_summary: The Malian army and its Russian partners entered the northeastern city of Kidal on the afternoon of Tuesday, October 6, as part of a military operation to retake the strategic city, according to local sources.

title: Aguelhoc : près de 8 000 déplacés et familles d’accueil bénéficient de coupons alimentaires du PAM
translated_title: Aguelhoc: nearly 8,000 displaced people and host families benefit from WFP food stamps

Le PAM accorde une attention particulière aux femmes enceintes ou allaitantes et aux enfants

Guest of the week of the humanitarian magazine Fabu dirène, Aline Samu Nkuelo, WFP Representative and Country Director in Mali, explains that the assistance targets both displaced people and host families, themselves facing strong pressure on their resources . “The displaced people found refuge with families, communities that found themselves sharing the meagre resources they still had,” she stresses. title: Malian army enters strategic northern city of Kidal
excerpt: The Malian army said it had entered the strategic northern city of Kidal after Tuareg-led separatists announced the withdrawal of their forces as the military advanced. Two Malian military officers told AFP on Tuesday that government forces had entered the city without encountering resistance. A military convoy left the town of Anefis earlier in the day and “entered Kidal shortly before 1:00 pm,” one officer said. “We encountered no resistance. We are on the ground,” he added. Another officer said government forces had “arrived in Kidal ahead of schedule”. title: Kidal : l’armée malienne reprend le contrôle de la ville
translated_title: Kidal: the Malian army regains control of the city
excerpt: L’armée malienne a repris, ce mardi 6 octobre, le contrôle de Kidal, dans le nord du Mali. Les Forces armées maliennes sont entrées dans la ville sans résistance. Ce retour intervient plus de cinq mois après la prise de Kidal par le Front de libération de l’Azawad (FLA), allié au Groupe de soutien à l’islam et aux musulmans (JNIM). Plusieurs sources sécuritaires confirment cette entrée des Fama à Kidal.Les forces armées maliennes poursuivent leur déploiement à l’intérieur de la ville, jusque-là contrôlée par le FLA. Dans un communiqué, le mouvement armé, le Front de libération de l’azawad FLA, affirme avoir décidé de se retirer de la ville afin de préserver la vie des rares populations civiles qui y sont encore présentes. Fief des groupes rebelles depuis 2012, Kidal avait été reprise par l’armée malienne en 2023. Les FAMa avaient cependant perdu le contrôle de la ville le 25 avril 2026, à la suite d’attaques coordonnées de la coalition FLA-JNIM. This return comes more than five months after the capture of Kidal by the Azawad Liberation Front (Fla), allied to the Group for the Support of Islam and Muslims (JNIM) Several security sources confirm this entry of the Fama into Kidal. The Malian armed forces continue their deployment inside the city, previously controlled by the Fla. The FAMa, however, had lost control of the city on April 25, 2026, following coordinated attacks by the FLA-JNIM coalition. A recovery in a particular regional context The recovery of Kidal comes at a time when Mali and Algeria are renewing their cooperation.

title: Mali : Lancement d’opérations aéroterrestres d’envergure dans la région de Kidal
translated_title: Mali: Launch of major air-land operations in the Kidal region

Elle a également pour buts de détruire leurs sanctuaires ainsi que leurs réseaux d’approvisionnement, afin de restaurer durablement la sécurité des populations et de garantir la libre circulation des personnes et des biens. L’institution militaire invite les populations à poursuivre leur collaboration avec les forces de défense et de sécurité en signalant tout mouvement ou comportement suspect. title: Au Burkina Faso, libération d’une centaine de partisans de l’imam Kindo « formés » par les militaires
translated_title: In Burkina Faso, release of a hundred supporters of Imam Kindo "trained" by the military
excerpt: Au Burkina Faso, libération d’une centaine de partisans de l’imam Kindo « formés » par les militaires Interpellés il y a quatre mois et « redressés » en camp militaire, des dizaines de partisans du prédicateur sunnite burkinabè Mohamad Ishaq Kindo ont été remis en liberté. L’imam critique du régime reste, lui, incarcéré. Alors que le Front anti-putschiste (Frap) de Burkinabè en exil tentait d’actualiser les statistiques des « disparus d’Ibrahim Traoré » – ceux qu’on expose au « front » et ceux dont on n’a aucune preuve de vie – le régime avait surpris, en mai, en s’en prenant au coordinateur du Conseil des oulémas sunnites et à nombre de ses fidèles. Quatre mois plus tard, une centaine de partisans de l’imam Mohamad Ishaq Kindo viennent d’être libérés. Si l’actuel chef de l’État ne quitte son look militarisé très étudié que pour les prières musulmanes et si l’actuelle révolution burkinabè n’est guère hostile aux pouvoirs traditionnels et spirituels, une loi relative aux libertés religieuses a été adoptée le 20 juin, à l’unanimité, par l’Assemblée législative du peuple (ALP). L’object
translated_excerpt: In Burkina Faso, dozens of supporters of the Burkinabe Sunni preacher Mohamad Ishaq Kindo were released following the release of a hundred followers of Imam Kindo who were "trained" by the military, arrested four months ago and "straightened out" in a military camp. The regime's critical imam remains incarcerated While the Anti-Putschist Front (Frap) of Burkinabe in exile was trying to update the statistics of the "disappeared of Ibrahim Traoré" – those who are exposed to the "front" and those of whom there is no evidence of life – the regime had surprised, in May, by attacking the coordinator of the Council of Sunni Ulemas and many of its faithful. Four months later, a hundred followers of Imam Mohamad Ishaq Kindo have just been released . If the current head of state leaves his highly studied militarized look only for Muslim prayers and if the current Burkinabe revolution is hardly hostile to traditional and spiritual powers, a law on religious freedoms was unanimously adopted on June 20 by the People's Legislative Assembly (PLA).
article_summary: In Burkina Faso, dozens of supporters of the Burkinabe Sunni preacher Mohamad Ishaq Kindo were released following the release of a hundred followers of Imam Kindo who were "trained" by the military, arrested four months ago and "straightened out" in a military camp.

title: Mali : le FLA annonce un repli stratégique de Kidal face à l’armée
translated_title: Mali: Fla announces strategic withdrawal of Kidal from the army
excerpt: Mali : le FLA annonce un repli stratégique de Kidal face à l’armée Mali: La rébellion touareg du FLA annonce se retirer de Kidal face à l'opération de l'armée. Les rebelles indépendantistes touareg du Front de libération de l’Azawad (FLA), qui avaient pris le contrôle fin avril de la localité stratégique malienne de Kidal, annonce mardi procéder à « un repli stratégique » de leurs forces face aux opérations de l’armée pour reprendre cette ville du nord. « Face aux risques croissants pesant sur les rares populations civiles encore présentes dans la ville par l’utilisation disproportionnée de vecteurs aériens par les mercenaires russes de l’Africa Corps et (…) la junte militaire de Bamako, le Commandement militaire du FLA décide de procéder à un repli stratégique et maîtrisé de ses forces de la localité de Kidal », annonce le FLA dans un communiqué transmis à l’AFP. Source : AFP
translated_excerpt: Mali: the Fla announces a strategic withdrawal of Kidal against the army Mali: the Tuareg rebellion of the Fla announces its withdrawal from Kidal against the army's operation. The Tuareg independence rebels of the Azawad Liberation Front (Fla), who had taken control of the strategic Malian town of Kidal at the end of April, announced on Tuesday that they were carrying out a "strategic withdrawal" of their forces in the face of army operations to recapture this city from the north. "Faced with the growing risks weighing on the few civilian populations still present in the city by the disproportionate use of aerial vectors by the Russian mercenaries of the Africa Corps and (...) the military junta of Bamako, the Fla Military Command decides to carry out a strategic and controlled withdrawal of its forces from the locality of Kidal," the Fla said in a statement sent to AFP. Source: AFP

excerpt: The Malian army said it has entered the strategic northern city of Kidal, which was captured in April by Tuareg separatists who announced their withdrawal earlier Tuesday as the military advanced. "We have just arrived in Kidal ahead of schedule," a staff officer told AFP, with a second officer confirming the arrival. In a statement released on Tuesday, the general staff claimed for the first time to have "engaged in large-scale air-land operations in the Kidal region" with its " Russian partners" in order to " neutralize armed terrorist groups," "destroyed their sanctuaries" and "sustainably restored the security of the population" and their "freedom of movement." Retaking the city would be a powerful symbol in favor of the transitional authorities, who had been humiliated by last April's defeat. title: Mali: les FAMa reprennent le contrôle de Kidal, le FLA parle de « repli stratégique »

Le mouvement indépendantiste parle d’un « repli stratégique et maîtrisé » de ses forces dans le communiqué n°022/BE/FLA/2026, signé à Kidal par son porte-parole, Mohamed Elmaouloud Ramadane. Kidal repasse sous contrôle de l’armée après cinq mois et onze jours aux mains du FLA, qui l’avait prise le 25 avril, et moins de trois ans après sa première reprise par Bamako en novembre 2023. D’après Jeune Afrique, l’armée et ses alliés d’Africa Corps sont entrés dans la ville après le départ des combattants du FLA. Le FLA avait pris la ville en s’alliant au Groupe de soutien à l’islam et aux musulmans (Jnim), branche sahélienne d’Al-Qaïda. Les frappes de l’état-major malien du 5 octobre visaient des positions de groupes armés dans la région de Kidal. title: L’offensive militaire malienne a commencé dans la région de Kidal
translated_title: Mali's military offensive has begun in the Kidal region
excerpt: Les réseaux sociaux maliens favorables au régime ont relayé lundi des images, filmées le même jour, de frappes de drones sur la ville de Tinzawaten, à la frontière algérienne. Ces frappes annoncent le début de l’offensive de reprise de Kidal et de la région septentrionale qui était annoncée pour la fin de la saison des pluies. Tinzawaten était jusqu’ici un sanctuaire militaire du Front de libération de l’Azawad, cible principale de l’offensive de reconquête du nord. Le groupe djihadiste affilié à Al Qaïda, le JNIM, est beaucoup moins présent militairement que son allié rebelle dans le septentrion, contrairement au reste du pays. La nouvelle position de l’Algérie, en plein réchauffement de ses relations avec le Mali, a facilité ces bombardements. Le président algérien Abdelmadjid Tebboune a d’ailleurs annoncé samedi que son pays ne s’immiscerait pas dans les affaires intérieures de « ce pays frère », affirmant : « nous sommes beaucoup plus proches l’un de l’autre qu’on ne le pense. » Depuis plusieurs jours, un déploiement important de l’armée malienne et de ses partenaires et auxiliai
translated_excerpt: Malian social networks favorable to the regime relayed Monday images, filmed the same day, of drone strikes on the city of Tinzawaten, on the Algerian border. These strikes herald the start of the offensive to recapture Kidal and the northern region that was announced for the end of the rainy season . Tinzawaten was until now a military sanctuary of the Azawad Liberation Front, the main target of the offensive to reconquer the north. The jihadist group affiliated with Al Qaeda, the JNIM, is much less militarily present than its rebel ally in the north, unlike the rest of the country. Algeria's new position, in full warming of its relations with Mali, facilitated these bombings Algerian President Abdelmadjid Tebboune announced on Saturday that his country would not interfere in the internal affairs of "this brotherly country", saying: "We are much closer to each other than we think." For several days, a major deployment of the Malian army and its partners and auxiliai
article_summary: Malian social networks favorable to the regime relayed Monday images, filmed the same day, of drone strikes on the city of Tinzawaten, on the Algerian border. These strikes herald the start of the offensive to recapture Kidal and the northern region that was announced for the end of the rainy season . Tinzawaten was until now a military sanctuary of the Azawad Liberation Front, the main target of the offensive to reconquer the north.

title: Burkina : baisse des accidents de la route en août et septembre
translated_title: Burkina: decrease in road accidents in August and September

En septembre, 1.450 accidents ont été recensés, faisant 1.055 blessés et 69 morts, contre 1.516 accidents, 1.347 blessés et 79 décès en août. Sur les neuf premiers mois de 2026, le pays a enregistré 15.853 accidents de la circulation, ayant fait 12.858 blessés et 910 morts, précise le ministère. Le nombre d’accidents avait atteint 1.945 en janvier, avant de s’établir à 1.794 en février, 1.803 en mars, 1.992 en avril, 1.783 en mai, 1.826 en juin et 1.744 en juillet. In September, 1,450 accidents were recorded, resulting in 1,055 injuries and 69 deaths, compared to 1,516 accidents, 1,347 injuries and 79 deaths in August In the first nine months of 2026, the country recorded 15,853 traffic accidents, resulting in 12,858 injuries and 910 deaths, the ministry said.

translated_title: Mali: the army recaptures the strategic city of Kidal, deserted by the Bamako rebels (AFP)

Cette reprise de Kidal, bastion de la rébellion, représente une victoire pour l'armée malienne, qui en avait été chassée en avril par le Front de libération de l'Azawad (FLA) et ses alliés jihadistes du Groupe de soutien à l'islam et aux musulmans (JNIM), affilié à Al-Qaïda. Cette perte de Kidal avait à l'époque constitué un véritable camouflet pour les forces armées maliennes, survenue lors d'attaques d'ampleur et coordonnées contre des positions de la junte et de l'armée dans plusieurs villes, y compris aux abords de Bamako. Depuis 2012, le Mali fait face à une profonde crise sécuritaire, nourrie notamment par les violences de groupes jihadistes, de leurs alliés du FLA et de groupes criminels communautaires. Mais le pays est plongé dans une situation sécuritaire encore plus critique depuis fin avril 2026 et le lancement de ces attaques coordonnées à travers le pays par le JNIM

This loss of Kidal had at the time been a real slap in the face for the Malian armed forces, which had occurred during large-scale and coordinated attacks against junta and army positions in several cities, including on the outskirts of Bamako. title: San : la sécurité sous couvre-feu
translated_title: San: security under curfew
excerpt: La circulation nocturne est interdite depuis le 24 août dans l’ensemble de la région de San. La mesure répond à une dégradation sécuritaire, mais sa durée indéterminée exige des modalités précises pour protéger la vie quotidienne. De 22 h 30 à 6 heures, habitants, véhicules, motos et vélos doivent désormais rester à l’arrêt dans les sept cercles et les 42 communes de la région de San. La décision signée par le gouverneur, le colonel-major Ousmane Sangaré, est applicable jusqu’à nouvel ordre. Seuls les moyens de transport des Forces de défense et de sécurité ainsi que ceux engagés dans des missions officielles dûment autorisées sont explicitement exemptés. Le gouvernorat motive cette restriction par une « dégradation préoccupante » de la situation sécuritaire et une recrudescence de l’insécurité. Le couvre-feu intervient quinze jours après l’attaque menée le 9 août contre le camp du 23e Régiment d’infanterie de San. L’armée affirme que les assaillants ont utilisé des mitrailleuses lourdes, des drones et deux véhicules blindés, dont l’un aurait franchi le mur de l’emprise. Elle soutien
translated_excerpt: Nighttime traffic has been banned since August 24 throughout the San area. The measure responds to a safe degradation, but its indefinite duration requires precise modalities to protect daily life. From 10:30 p.m. to 6 a.m., residents, vehicles, motorcycles and bicycles must now remain stationary in the seven circles and 42 municipalities of the San . The decision signed by the Governor, Colonel-Major Ousmane Sangaré, is applicable until further notice. Only means of transport of the Defence and Security Forces as well as those engaged in duly authorized official missions are explicitly exempted. The governorate motivates this restriction by a "worrying deterioration" of the security situation and an increase in insecurity The curfew comes fifteen days after the attack carried out on 9 August against the camp of the 23rd San Infantry Regiment. The army claims that the attackers used heavy machine guns, drones and two armoured vehicles, one of which is said to have breached the right-of-way wall.
article_summary: Nighttime traffic has been banned since August 24 throughout the San area. The measure responds to a safe degradation, but its indefinite duration requires precise modalities to protect daily life. From 10:30 p.m.

title: مالي.. الجيش “يقضي” على مسلّحين في ضربات جوية وبرّية بتنزواتين
translated_title: Mali.. The army “eliminates” militants in air and ground strikes in two attacks
excerpt: أعلن الجيش المالي، مساء اليوم الاثنين، تنفيذ “ضربات جوية وبرية دقيقة” ضد مواقع للجماعات الإرهابية المسلحة في بلدة “تينزواتين” والمناطق المجاورة لها بقطاع كيدال، أقصى شمال شرق البلاد. وأوضح في بيان، أن هذه العمليات تأتي استكمالاً للجهود العسكرية المستمرة ضمن عملية “دوغوكولوكو” للتأمين والمراقبة الدائمة للتراب الوطني. وأسفرت الحصيلة المؤقتة للضربات حسب البيان عن مقتل عدد من المسلحين، إضافة إلى تدمير نحو عشر سيارات دفع رباعي وشاحنة وعدة دراجات نارية ومعدات عسكرية أخرى. وأكد استمرار “عمليات الاستطلاع والتمشيط للقيام بتقييم دقيق لنتائج الضربات والقضاء على أي تهديد.” في غضون ذلك، كانت جبهة تحرير أزواد، قد نفت اليوم الاثنين، أي تقدم للجيش المالي والفيلق الإفريقي الروسي نحو كيدال. وأوضحت عبر المتحدث باسمها محمد مولود رمضان، أن حضور الجيش يتمثل فقط في غارات جوية بواسطة المسيرات في المنطقة.

article_summary: On Monday evening, the Malian army announced the implementation of "precise air and ground strikes" against positions of armed terrorist groups in the town of "Tinzoaten" and its neighboring areas in the Kidal sector, the far northeast of the country. He explained in a statement that these operations come as a complement to the ongoing military efforts within Operation Dogokoloko to secure and permanently monitor the national territory.

title: Commandement militaire : Les lignes bougent après le 25 avril
translated_title: Military Command: Lines move after April 25
excerpt: Les nominations du 29 mai 2026 réorganisent plusieurs postes sensibles de la chaîne militaire malienne. Elles interviennent après une offensive qui a modifié les priorités sécuritaires de Bamako. Ce changement ne se limite pas à une circulation de noms dans l’appareil militaire. Il intervient après les attaques coordonnées du 25 avril, revendiquées par le JNIM et le Front de libération de l’Azawad, dans un contexte marqué par la mort de l’ancien ministre de la Défense, le Général Sadio Camara, la reprise directe du portefeuille de la Défense par le Président de la Transition, le Général d’armée Assimi Goïta et la nomination du Général Oumar Diarra comme ministre délégué chargé de la Défense. Menaces Depuis cette date, le dispositif malien fait face à des menaces plus complexes. La jonction opérationnelle entre la mouvance jihadiste affiliée à Al-Qaïda et certains groupes armés du Nord donne aux attaques une autre portée. Elle combine pression militaire, guerre d’axes, frappes contre des positions symboliques, communication de guerre et contrôle de portions stratégiques du territoire.
translated_excerpt: The appointments of May 29, 2026 reorganize several sensitive positions in the Malian military chain. They come after an offensive that changed Bamako's security priorities. This change is not limited to a circulation of names in the military apparatus . It comes after the coordinated attacks of 25 April, claimed by the JNIM and the Azawad Liberation Front, in a context marked by the death of the former Minister of Defence, General Sadio Camara, the direct takeover of the Defence portfolio by the President of the Transition, Army General Assimi Goïta and the appointment of General Oumar Diarra as Deputy Minister in charge of Defence . Threats Since that date, the Malian system has faced more complex threats. The operational junction between the Al-Qaeda-affiliated jihadist movement and some northern armed groups gives the attacks a different scope. It combines military pressure, axis warfare, strikes against symbolic positions, war communication and control of strategic portions of the territory.
article_summary: The appointments of May 29, 2026 reorganize several sensitive positions in the Malian military chain. They come after an offensive that changed Bamako's security priorities. This change is not limited to a circulation of names in the military apparatus .

Le bilan provisoire établi par les secouristes fait état d'un mort, un homme d'une quarantaine d'années, dont le décès a été confirmé par les services médicaux, et de 30 blessés parmi les 65 victimes répertoriées. Les blessés ont été évacués d'urgence vers le Centre de santé de référence (CSRef) de Bla pour y recevoir les soins nécessaires. title: Niger Coup: Survival of the Military Regime and Growing Fragility
excerpt: The attempted coup in Niamey on the night of 28–29 August 2026 exposed a fundamental contradiction at the heart of General Abdourahamane Tiani’s rule. Although the regime survived its serious internal challenge since the July 2023 coup against Mohamed Bazoum, the episode revealed fractures within the armed forces, declining confidence in the government’s ability to improve security, and dependence on foreign military support. Participants reportedly included special-forces personnel with experience fighting in Tillabéri. title: Burkina Faso Holds Rally to Mark Traore Coup Anniversary
excerpt: Thousands of supporters of Burkina Faso’s military government gathered overnight in the capital, Ouagadougou, and other parts of the country to mark the fourth anniversary of the coup that brought Captain Ibrahim Traore to power. The rally, organised at the initiative of the junta, began at 6 pm on Wednesday and was described by organisers as a vigil celebrating Traore’s “Popular Progressive Revolution”. The 38-year-old military leader seized power in a September 2022 coup and has since presented himself as a Pan-African figure opposing Western influence on the continent. The anniversary events were broadcast on state television and continued into the night, with concerts featuring artists praising the military government and its record in power. Many participants carried posters bearing Traore’s image. When he assumed power, Traore pledged to end the terrorist violence that has affected Burkina Faso since 2015, promising to restore security within months. However, the country continues to experience terrorist attacks despite government claims of progress against armed groups and inc
article_summary: Thousands of supporters of Burkina Faso’s military government gathered overnight in the capital, Ouagadougou, and other parts of the country to mark the fourth anniversary of the coup that brought Captain Ibrahim Traore to power. The rally, organised at the initiative of the junta, began at 6 pm on Wednesday and was described by organisers as a vigil celebrating Traore’s “Popular Progressive Revolution”.

title: Lutte contre la fraude et l’orpaillage clandestin: Condor Autorité et ses hommes frappent fort
translated_title: Fight against fraud and clandestine gold mining: Condor Authority and its men strike hard
excerpt: L’Unité Combattante des Eaux et Forêts basée à Djikologo (Djôrô, ex-sud-ouest burkinabè) a mené, du 26 au 27 septembre 2026, une série d’opérations contre les trafics illicites, la fraude et l’orpaillage clandestin. Ces opérations ont permis d’obtenir des résultats significatifs, illustrant la détermination des agents à protéger les ressources naturelles, à préserver l’environnement et à faire respecter la loi. 35 tonnes d’amandes de karité saisies Le samedi 26 septembre 2026, les éléments de l’Unité ont intercepté et saisi, sur l’axe Djikologo-Dissine, un camion-remorque transportant environ 35 tonnes d’amandes de karité. La cargaison ne disposait d’aucun document légal attestant sa traçabilité et sa destination. 40 cartons de boissons frelatées retirés du circuit Dans le cadre des mêmes opérations, les agents de l’Unité ont saisi 40 cartons de boissons frelatées, transportés à bord d’un tricycle et destinés à la vente illicite. Présentant un risque sérieux pour la santé publique, ces produits ont été retirés de la circulation. Ils seront détruits suivant les procédures réglementair
translated_excerpt: The Water and Forestry Combatant Unit based in Djikologo (Djôrô, former south-west of Burkina Faso) conducted, from 26 to 27 September 2026, a series of operations against illicit trafficking, fraud and clandestine gold mining. These operations have achieved significant results, illustrating the determination of agents to protect natural resources, preserve the environment and enforce the law . 35 tons of shea kernels seized On Saturday, September 26, 2026, the elements of the Unit intercepted and seized, on the Djikologo-Dissine axis, a trailer truck carrying about 35 tons of shea kernels. The cargo did not have any legal document attesting to its traceability and destination . 40 cartons of adulterated beverages removed from the circuit As part of the same operations, the officers of the Unit seized 40 cartons of adulterated beverages, transported on board a tricycle and intended for illicit sale. As they pose a serious risk to public health, these products have been withdrawn from circulation. They will be destroyed according to regulatory procedures
article_summary: The Water and Forestry Combatant Unit based in Djikologo (Djôrô, former south-west of Burkina Faso) conducted, from 26 to 27 September 2026, a series of operations against illicit trafficking, fraud and clandestine gold mining. These operations have achieved significant results, illustrating the determination of agents to protect natural resources, preserve the environment and enforce the law .

title: Burkina Faso's military leaders mark four years in power
excerpt: People gathered in Ougadougou’s Place de la Révolution on Wednesday night to mark four years since Captain Ibrahim Traoré came to power in a coup. title: Burkina Faso: Des opposants en exil publient une liste documentée de 86 enlèvements perpétrés par la junte
translated_title: Burkina Faso: Opponents in exile publish a documented list of 86 kidnappings perpetrated by the junta
excerpt: Mis en ligne sur les réseaux sociaux sous le titre « Les disparus d'Ibrahim Traoré » à l'occasion du quatrième anniversaire du putsch militaire du 30 septembre 2022, ce trombinoscope entend dénoncer l'autoritarisme de la junte au pouvoir à Ouagadougou et honorer la mémoire de celles et ceux qui ont été victimes de sa répression. Quatre ans de règne et 86 enlèvements documentés : tel est l'autre bilan de la junte au pouvoir au Burkina Faso qu'un groupe d'opposants burkinabè en exil, le Front anti-putchistes (Frap), a voulu mettre en avant, ce mercredi 30 septembre, pendant qu'à Ouagadougou, les autorités célébraient le quatrième anniversaire de l'accession au pouvoir du capitaine Ibrahim Traoré. title: Mali: more than 2,400 schools remain closed as insecurity disrupts new school year
excerpt: Mali's new school year began Thursday with more than 2,400 schools unable to reopen, as worsening insecurity and the growing presence of jihadist groups continue to disrupt education. The 2026-2027 academic year has been declared the “Year of Education and Culture” by President Assimi Goïta, but thousands of children are starting the year without access to their classrooms. According to figures from Mali's Education Ministry, the number of closed schools has continued to rise in recent years as violence spreads across parts of the country. The closures are affecting communities already facing displacement and disruption from the conflict, leaving children with fewer opportunities to continue their education. The government has made education a priority, but the security situation remains a major obstacle to reopening schools in affected areas. As the new academic year begins, the challenge for Mali is not only to get children back into classrooms, but also to ensure that schools can remain open and safe despite the continuing insecurity.
article_summary: Mali's new school year began Thursday with more than 2,400 schools unable to reopen, as worsening insecurity and the growing presence of jihadist groups continue to disrupt education. Il a, au nom du président de la Transition et de l’ensemble du gouvernement, adressé toutes ses félicitations aux forces de défense et de sécurité pour cette opération réussie. Notons qu’en dehors des plaquettes de cocaïne, les gendarmes ont également saisi un véhicule de marque Toyota, trois téléphones portables de type Android de marques Samsung

The Raffinor-BF facility in Ouagadougou cost more than $19 million and has a refining capacity of 164 tonnes of gold per year, with plans to eventually increase capacity to 515 tonnes. The government said that the refinery will help regulate the informal mining sector, curb smuggling and keep more value from gold production within the country. The government has also linked illegal gold trading to the financing of Islamist armed groups. title: Amnesty Report Accuses Mali Army, Wagner Group of War Crimes
excerpt: Amnesty Report Accuses Mali Army, Wagner Group of War Crimes A new report by Amnesty International has accused the Malian army and the Russian-backed Wagner Group of committing war crimes during joint operations between 2023 and 2025. The report, No One Is Spared: War Crimes Committed by the Malian Army and Foreign Allied Forces Along the Mauritanian Border, documents the killing of at least 34 civilians across seven areas in Mali between June 2023 and December 2025. ''The Malian authorities cannot dismiss these serious allegations without opening impartial and effective investigations into the alleged crimes,'' said Marceau Sivieude, Amnesty International's Regional Director for West and Central Africa. The campaign group has urged the warring parties to protect civilians during military operations and comply with international humanitarian law, calling on authorities to ''urgently clarify the chain of command under which foreign personnel act in the country, and monitor their conduct through an independent, domestic accountability mechanism". title: Ségou : Une trentaine de terroristes du JNIM et du FLA neutralisés par les FAMa et l'Africa Corps
translated_title: Segou: About thirty JNIM and Fla terrorists neutralized by the FAMa and the Africa Corps
excerpt: Ségou : Une trentaine de terroristes du JNIM et du FLA neutralisés par les FAMa et l'Africa Corps Une opération militaire conjointe menée par l'Africa Corps des Forces armées de la Fédération de Russie et les Forces armées maliennes (FAMa) a abouti, ce dimanche, à la destruction d'un important groupe terroriste dans la région de Ségou. Selon les informations relayées par l'Africa Corps, l'engagement a ciblé une coalition de combattants affiliés au Front de Libération de l'Azawad (FLA) et au Groupe de soutien à l'islam et aux musulmans (JNIM). Le bilan provisoire de l'opération fait état d'une trentaine de terroristes éliminés. Les forces conjointes ont également saisi 20 armes de petit calibre ainsi qu'une quantité importante de munitions sur le site des affrontements. Cette action s'inscrit dans le cadre de la poursuite des opérations de sécurisation du centre du pays, témoignant d'une coordination renforcée entre les forces maliennes et leurs partenaires russes sur le terrain. T.Sindy/Malijet.com
translated_excerpt: Ségou: About thirty JNIM and Fla terrorists neutralized by the FAMa and the Africa Corps A joint military operation led by the Africa Corps of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation and the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) resulted, this Sunday, in the destruction of a large terrorist group in the Ségou region According to information relayed by the Africa Corps, the engagement targeted a coalition of fighters affiliated with the Azawad Liberation Front (Fla) and the Group for the Support of Islam and Muslims (JNIM). The provisional assessment of the operation shows that about thirty terrorists have been eliminated. The joint forces also seized 20 small arms as well as a significant amount of ammunition at the site of the clashes . This action is part of the ongoing security operations in the centre of the country, demonstrating enhanced coordination between the Malian forces and their Russian partners on the ground. T.Sindy/Malijet.com

title: Traoré marks four years in power, following Sankara’s legacy
excerpt: Captain Ibrahim Traoré has now led Burkina Faso for four years, the same length of time Thomas Sankara was in power. Both came to power as young, red-beret-wearing army captains, promising national sovereignty, Pan-Africanism and greater economic independence. Sankara, who seized power in 1983, launched what he called a “democratic and popular revolution,” promoting education, women’s empowerment, self-reliance and local production. He was assassinated in 1987. Nearly four decades later, Traoré says he is carrying Sankara’s torch forward but under very different conditions. His government has nationalised gold mines, promoted local industries and launched Faso Mebo, a major infrastructure programme aimed at building roads and developing cities using local resources. But the biggest difference is security. Burkina Faso remains under pressure from jihadist groups, with large parts of the country affected by violence and some towns facing blockades. Traoré has also taken a harder line politically. Journalists, magistrates and civil society figures have been forcibly recruited and sent t
article_summary: Captain Ibrahim Traoré has now led Burkina Faso for four years, the same length of time Thomas Sankara was in power. Both came to power as young, red-beret-wearing army captains, promising national sovereignty, Pan-Africanism and greater economic independence. Sankara, who seized power in 1983, launched what he called a “democratic and popular revolution,” promoting education, women’s empowerment, self-reliance and local production.

title: بينهم قيادات.. الجيش المالي يعلن تحييد 50 مسلحا في كيدال
translated_title: Among them are leaders of the Malian army announcing the neutralization of 50 militants in Kidal.
excerpt: أعلنت القوات المسلحة المالية تحييد ما لا يقل عن 50 مسلحا خلال ضربات نفذتها على بعد نحو 45 كيلومترا شمال شرقي أبيبارا بمنطقة كيدال. وقالت هيئة الأركان العامة للقوات المسلحة، في بيان الأحد، إن معلومات استخباراتية مكّنت من تحديد عدة نقاط تجمع لجماعات مسلحة ووجود بعض مسؤوليها، إضافة إلى عتاد حربي مهم. وأضافت أن المواقع المحددة استُهدفت بعد تأكيد المعلومات وتقييم الوضع، وأسفرت العملية، وفق حصيلة مؤقتة، عن تحييد مسلحين بينهم قيادات، وتدمير عدد من المعدات الحربية. وأوضحت أن عمليات المراقبة والاستطلاع تتواصل في المنطقة لتقييم آثار الضربات وإعداد حصيلة نهائية، والبحث عن أي تهديدات متبقية وتحييدها، مشيرة إلى أن العملية تأتي في إطار عملية «دوغوكولوكو» التي تنفذها القوات المسلحة المالية بدعم من شركائها.
translated_excerpt: The Malian armed forces announced the neutralization of at least 50 militants during strikes some 45 kilometers northeast of Abiara in the Kidal region. In a statement on Sunday, the General Staff of the Armed Forces said that intelligence information enabled the identification of several assembly points for armed groups and the presence of some of their officials, in addition to important military equipment. It added that the specific sites were targeted after confirming information and assessing the situation, and the operation resulted, according to an interim outcome, in the neutralization of militants, including leaders, and the destruction of a number of war equipment. She explained that surveillance and reconnaissance operations are continuing in the region to assess the effects of the strikes and prepare a final outcome, and to search for and neutralize any remaining threats, noting that the operation comes within the framework of Operation Dogokoloko, which is carried out by the Malian armed forces with the support of its partners.
article_summary: The Malian armed forces announced the neutralization of at least 50 militants during strikes some 45 kilometers northeast of Abiara in the Kidal region. title: Diplomatic Divide Threatens Sahel Security
excerpt: Nigeria’s northern states are experiencing a surge in terrorism spreading from the Sahel as strained diplomatic relations with Niger’s ruling junta complicates cross-border security. Tensions between the two countries began after the 2023 coup that overthrew Niger’s democratically elected president, Mohamed Bazoum. The situation worsened when Niger joined Burkina Faso and Mali in the Alliance of Sahelian States (AES) and withdrew from the Economic Community of West African States (ECOWAS) in 2025. It later exited the Multinational Joint Task Force (MNJTF), which confronts terrorism in the Lake Chad Basin. After withdrawing from ECOWAS, Niger and its AES allies have repeatedly denounced their southern neighbors — with a special focus on Nigeria — for allegedly meddling in their internal affairs and attempting to destabilize their governments. title: Lutte antiterroriste : nouvelles frappes ciblées des FAMa à Sévaré, Dioura et Tessalit
translated_title: Counter-terrorism: new targeted FAMa strikes in Sévaré, Dioura and Tessalit
excerpt: Lutte antiterroriste : nouvelles frappes ciblées des FAMa à Sévaré, Dioura et Tessalit Dans le cadre de l'opération Dougoukoloko, les Forces armées maliennes (FAMa) ont multiplié les frappes ciblées ces derniers jours. Visant des caches logistiques et des éléments terroristes, ces actions illustrent la pression continue exercée sur les groupes armés à travers le pays. L'armée malienne ne laisse aucun répit aux groupes armés terroristes. Ces derniers jours, les troupes déployées sur le territoire ont conduit plusieurs opérations d'envergure, s'appuyant sur un renseignement de plus en plus affûté. Lundi 21 septembre, un regroupement de terroristes, dissimulé sous une épaisse végétation au nord-est de Sévaré, a été localisé puis frappé avec précision. Aucune reprise de mouvement n'a été observée sur la zone après l'intervention. Simultanément, dans le secteur de Dioura, entre Séti et Kologuiri, les patrouilles ont découvert un véhicule blindé ennemi soigneusement camouflé sous un arbre. Après analyse, le blindé et ses occupants ont été immédiatement neutralisés. L'offensive avait débuté
translated_excerpt: Counter-terrorism: new targeted FAMa strikes in Sévaré, Dioura and Tessalit As part of Operation Dougoukoloko, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) have stepped up targeted strikes in recent days. Targeting logistical caches and terrorist elements, these actions illustrate the ongoing pressure on armed groups across the country. The Malian army leaves no respite to the armed terrorist groups . In recent days, troops deployed in the territory have conducted several large-scale operations, relying on increasingly sharp intelligence. Monday, September 21, a group of terrorists, hidden under thick vegetation northeast of Sevare, was located and then hit with precision. No recovery of movement was observed in the area after the intervention . Simultaneously, in the Dioura sector, between Seti and Kologuiri, patrols discovered an enemy armoured vehicle carefully camouflaged under a tree. After analysis, the tank and its occupants were immediately neutralized. The offensive had begun
article_summary: As part of Operation Dougoukoloko, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) have stepped up targeted strikes in recent days. Targeting logistical caches and terrorist elements, these actions illustrate the ongoing pressure on armed groups across the country. The Malian army leaves no respite to the armed terrorist groups .

title: 66e anniversaire de l’indépendance à Koutiala :Le gouverneur appelle les populations à une «saine collaboration» avec FAMa
translated_title: 66th anniversary of independence in Koutiala:Governor calls on populations to "healthy collaboration" with FAMa
excerpt: Koutiala, 22 septembre (AMAP)– La région de Koutiala célèbre ce mardi 22 septembre 2026 le 66e anniversaire de l’indépendance du Mali. Présidée par le gouverneur, le Général de brigade Harouna Samaké, au rond-point Zanga Coulibaly, la cérémonie a été marquée par le dépôt d’une gerbe de fleurs à la mémoire des pionniers de l’indépendance, suivi d’un défilé militaire et civil, a constaté l’AMAP. Dans son bilan, le Général de brigade Harouna Samaké a indiqué que la région avait reçu 334.412 cartes biométriques dans le cadre de l’identification des citoyens, dont 291.505 ont été distribuées, soit un taux de 87%. Sur le plan sécuritaire, il a fait état d’incidents sporadiques attribués à des groupes armés terroristes, notamment des braquages, des attaques de postes de sécurité, des poses d’engins explosifs sur les axes Koutiala-Koury et Koutiala-Sikasso, ainsi que des extorsions de biens. Selon lui, la menace tend à se déplacer des zones frontalières vers l’intérieur de la région. La coordination entre la Police, la Gendarmerie, la Garde nationale et le 83e Régiment d’infanterie motorisée
translated_excerpt: Koutiala, September 22 (AMAP)– The Koutiala region celebrates this Tuesday, September 22, 2026, the 66th anniversary of Mali's independence. Chaired by the governor, Brigadier General Harouna Samaké, at the Zanga Coulibaly roundabout, the ceremony was marked by the laying of a wreath in memory of the pioneers of independence, followed by a military and civilian parade, noted AMAP . In his report, Brigadier General Harouna Samaké indicated that the region had received 334,412 biometric cards as part of the identification of citizens, of which 291,505 were distributed, a rate of 87% . On the security front, he reported sporadic incidents attributed to armed terrorist groups, including robberies, attacks on security posts, the laying of explosive devices on the Koutiala-Koury and Koutiala-Sikasso axes, as well as extortion of property. According to him, the threat tends to move from border areas to the interior of the region
article_summary: Koutiala, September 22 (AMAP)– The Koutiala region celebrates this Tuesday, September 22, 2026, the 66th anniversary of Mali's independence. Chaired by the governor, Brigadier General Harouna Samaké, at the Zanga Coulibaly roundabout, the ceremony was marked by the laying of a wreath in memory of the pioneers of independence, followed by a military and civilian parade, noted AMAP .

title: Burkina Faso: People caught in a perfect storm of conflict, displacement and food insecurity
excerpt: Alongside the release of the world's most neglected displacement crises in 2022 and the 2023 Global Report on Internal Displacement, the Norwegian Refugee Council (NRC) and the Internal Displacement Monitoring Center (IDMC) have worked together to identify the crucial yet often overlooked link between conflict, displacement and food security in Burkina Faso. For over a year, around 350,000 individuals have been trapped in Djibo, a city located in Burkina Faso's Sahel region. Among them, three-quarters are internally displaced people seeking refuge from the storms of conflict. Since February 2022, non-state armed groups have blockaded the city, planting explosives on roads and destroying critical infrastructure including bridges, water points and phone installations. Once a vibrant hub of trade and agriculture, Djibo is now cut off from the world. Fields lie abandoned, and food production has plummeted. Escalating prices have left many grappling with hunger, with some forced to resort to desperate measures such as eating leaves. Military convoys attempting to resupply Djibo residents
